name: eCola
summary: Universally recognized soda brand across the Grand Theft Auto universe with a notoriously high caffeine and sugar content. Prominently advertised on Leonida billboards.
description: eCola ('Deliciously Infectious!') returns in GTA VI as the primary soft drink brand dominating urban billboards, delivery trucks, and vending machines. In addition to classic red-and-white can branding, advertisements parody contemporary energy drink marketing with extreme sports sponsorships and wellness claims.

seo.title: eCola Brand: Lore & Billboards in GTA VI
seo.description: Complete breakdown of the eCola brand in GTA VI. Verified billboard locations, vending machine mechanics, delivery trucks, and satirical lore.
